mechanism: Amikacin is nephrotoxic and can impair renal function, potentially increasing tazarotene exposure and toxicity; tazarotene is teratogenic and amikacin may affect renal clearance of active metabolites.
action: Monitor renal function closely during concurrent use; avoid in pregnancy; assess for signs of tazarotene toxicity and ensure adequate hydration to minimize amikacin nephrotoxicity.
